meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会把原始数据整理成有叙事结构的故事，输出含关键洞察、可视化建议和行动号召的报告或演示文稿，并附带头条标题、过渡句等写作指导。
howto.when: 当要求做数据分析演示、创建数据报告或构建高管演示文稿时触发。

say.text: 把这份销售数据变成一个讲给CEO的故事，附上关键洞察和行动建议。
say.note: 它会按故事结构输出报告。

say.text: 用对比框架分析我们和竞品的数据，给出进入市场的建议。
say.note: 它会列出对比表格和加权评分。

say.text: 为季度业务回顾做一个一页仪表盘故事，标出亮点和风险。
say.note: 它会生成模板式的总结。

howto.what_en: This skill turns raw data into narrative-driven reports or presentations, using a setup-conflict-resolution structure, visual recommendations, and clear calls to action. It also provides writing guidance for headlines, transitions, and uncertainty.
howto.when_en: Activated when you ask Claude to present analytics to stakeholders, create data reports, or build executive presentations.

say_en.text: Turn this sales data into a story for the CEO, with key insights and action steps.
say_en.note: It will output a narrative-structured report.

say_en.text: Use the comparison framework to analyze our data vs. competitors and recommend market entry.
say_en.note: It will produce comparison tables and scoring.

say_en.text: Create a one-page dashboard story for the quarterly review, highlighting wins and risks.
say_en.note: It will generate a template-like summary.
